title: Practice: Short past passive participles: куплен, написан, открыт

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: If the verb of a sentence is transitive, the idea may be expressed in two ways: if we want to emphasize the performer of the action, we use the active voice; if we want to emphasize the object or target of the action, we express the same thought in the passive. *Студент купил книгу. — Книга куплена студентом.* In the passive construction the performer of the action is expressed by the instrumental case (студентом). The new relations are expressed in Russian by a special form of the verb which is called the short past passive participle (PPP). It is used only as a predicate in passive constructions. Past passive participles express the idea of a completed action and are almost exclusively… — DLI, Lessons 85–87.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
